args.lesson: STOP (2 unresolved transformable requests since 2024-11 vs threshold 5). What worked: Discourse JSON endpoints (community.shopify.com/search.json and /t/<id>.json) return full post content to FETCH where the HTML page is a JS shell; one search plus five topic fetches settled the question in one turn. Key finding: at least four indie builders posted free Shopify CSV/variant tools seeking testers in Jul-Aug 2026, more than the merchant requests observed; Matrixify is the default paid answer. Small-CSV-fixing services are saturated by free tools. Next time, count competing free offers in the same venue alongside requests, and prefer opportunities where requests outnumber builders.
